 Saturday's La Liga predictions including Atletico Madrid vs. Deportivo La Coruna
 By
 Matt
 Law 
 |
 24 Oct 2026 00:05 
 © Iconsport / PA Images 
 Today's La Liga predictions include Atletico Madrid 's clash with Deportivo La Coruna , and a contest between Valencia and Villarreal .
 Rayo Vallecano vs. Elche (Saturday, 1pm)
 © Imago / ZUMA Press Wire Rayo Vallecano and Elche will put their recent three-game unbeaten runs on the line when they lock horns in Spain's top flight on Saturday.
 The home team will enter the match off the back of a 1-1 draw against Getafe, while Elche's last game ended in a goalless draw with Villarreal.
 We say: Rayo Vallecano 2-1 Elche
 Both sides are in decent form, and we are expecting Saturday's match to be tight, but home advantage could allow Rayo to navigate their way to all three points.
 > Click here to read our full preview for Rayo Vallecano vs. Elche, including team news and predicted lineups 
 Racing de Santander vs. Espanyol (Saturday, 3.15pm)
 © Imago / Ricardo Larreina Amador Two teams in disappointing form will lock horns in Spain's top flight on Saturday, as Racing de Santander welcome Espanyol to Campos de Sport de El Sardinero.
 Racing are currently 17th in the La Liga table , boasting eight points from their opening nine matches, while Espanyol are 16th in the division, also on eight points.
 We say: Racing de Santander 1-1 Espanyol
 Cases can be made for either to win it, with both having quality in the final third of the field, but we are expecting the points to be shared in a low-scoring draw.
 > Click here to read our full preview for Racing de Santander vs. Espanyol, including team news and predicted lineups 
 Valencia vs. Villarreal (Saturday, 5.30pm)
 © Iconsport / Cesar Cebolla, Pressinphoto Both Valencia and Villarreal will be aiming to return to winning ways in Spain's top flight when they lock horns on Saturday afternoon.
 Los Che will enter the contest off the back of a goalless draw with Athletic Bilbao, while Villarreal played out a goalless draw with Elche in their last fixture.
 We say: Valencia 1-2 Villarreal
 Valencia will be the fresher of the two teams on Saturday, but Villarreal can call upon a lot of quality, and we just have a feeling that the Yellow Submarine will shade a close match here.
 > Click here to read our full preview for Valencia vs. Villarreal, including team news and predicted lineups 
 Atletico Madrid vs. Deportivo La Coruna (Saturday, 8pm)
 © Iconsport / Antonio Pozo / Pressinphoto Atletico Madrid will be aiming to make it six straight wins in Spain's top flight when they continue their campaign at home to Deportivo La Coruna on Saturday evening.
 Diego Simeone 's side will enter the match off the back of a 1-1 draw with Stuttgart in the Champions League, while Deportivo drew 1-1 with Levante in their last league match.
 We say: Atletico Madrid 2-0 Deportivo La Coruna
 Deportivo's attacking absences are harming them at the moment, and we are expecting an in-form Atletico to collect all three points on Saturday without any major drama.
